title: Special Executive Programme In Management and Leadership in Food Security
description: The SEP in Management and Leadership in Food Security equips leaders with strategic insights, policy frameworks, and innovative solutions to ensure sustainable food systems and global food security.
longDescription: This program provides a comprehensive understanding of front office operations, emphasizing strategies for identifying and meeting customer needs. It covers key principles of beverage management, legal considerations affecting beverage provision, and effective methods for controlling costs, ensuring operational efficiency and compliance in the hospitality sector.
courseDetails: Understand Essential Concepts in Food Safety and Hygiene – Learn the fundamental principles of maintaining a safe and hygienic food environment. Recognize the Value of Hygiene Across Different Food Types – Assess the importance of hygiene practices tailored to specific food categories. Identify Food Safety Hazards and Sources of Contamination – Analyze common risks and their potential impact on food safety. Implement Detection, Prevention, and Control Measures in Food Safety – Apply strategies to mitigate contamination risks and ensure food quality. Develop Leadership and Management Skills in Food Safety Operations – Enhance decision-making, compliance management, and team leadership in food safety and hygiene. This course provides a comprehensive understanding of food safety, hygiene, and leadership in the food and beverage industry. It covers essential concepts in food safety and hygiene, emphasizing the value of hygiene across different food types. Participants will explore food safety hazards, sources of contamination, and effective methods for detection, prevention, and control. Additionally, the course integrates leadership and management development programs to equip professionals with the necessary skills to oversee food safety operations, ensure compliance, and enhance overall organizational efficiency.
